title: Activepieces alternatives: options and prices | 50agents
description: Activepieces alternatives: n8n to keep self-hosting with 2,829 integrations, Make or Zapier for more apps, Power Automate for Microsoft 365, and 50agents.
answer: n8n also self-hosts and lists 2,829 integrations; Make and Zapier have larger app catalogs.
Power Automate fits Microsoft 365, and 50agents builds from plain words.
